title: carved wood chickadees
text: carved wood chickadees. I was very excited about these carved chickadees... wish they were a bit more uniform... and smaller.  These are HUGE chickadees - so not real life.  They are possibly hand carved - very irregular and painting that is also irregular. I'm ok with that..  The larger of the two, the clip is about ready to fall off, I will reattach it.  Over all, they are ok.  I just wish they were more delicate and real life size with better clip glue.

description: Create a classic Christmas scene with the Chickadee Clip Ornament set. Pair the spritely carved wood chickadees with vibrant cardinal ornaments to bring a touch of natural winter beauty to your holiday decorations. Size: 2 inches high x 4 inches wide x 1 inch deep.
